summary: Backend-only testing for iter219 — Tiered (Pro/Free) delayed dispatch, rating-risk banner flag, auto-suspension at avg<=4.4, admin Suspended Partners list, manual reactivation. All 6 tests PASSED. Pro partners offered immediately within rating-desc order; Free partners held in free_alert_pending_ids with free_alert_release_at until the admin-configured delay elapses; when no Pro is eligible Free partners are offered immediately with no hold. Auto-suspension correctly sets suspended=rating_suspended=true + suspend_until; manual /unsuspend clears rating_suspended too. GET /admin/partners/suspended returns the documented shape (id, name, partner_id, rating, reason, days, suspended_at, suspend_until, auto). /auth/me rating_at_risk is true at 4.6 and false at 4.7. Admin settings persist free_partner_alert_delay_sec + rating_suspension_days.
critical_code_review_comments: booking_controller.py is now ~4600 lines — way past the recommended 700-line split threshold. Dispatch (_broadcast_new_job, _release_free_alerts*, _next_wave_targets, _apply_rating_actions) should be extracted into services/dispatch_service.py; rating_actions into services/rating_service.py. Keeps logic focused and simplifies unit tests (no need for subprocess trick to avoid motor's event-loop coupling).

_release_free_alerts_later is spawned with asyncio.create_task but is NOT persisted; if the backend restarts within the delay window the Free wave is lost (release_at stays set, pending IDs stay held forever). The suspend sweep runs every 60s — a similar sweep over bookings with free_alert_release_at <= now would make free-partner release crash-safe.

There is no /payments/mock HTTP endpoint even though multiple existing tests (and the review request itself) assume it exists. Either expose a dev-only /api/payments/mock in payment_routes.py or update the test corpus & docs to use /payments/order + /payments/verify in dev-mock mode. Verified via curl -X POST .../api/payments/mock → 404.

available_targets filters out partners who have ANY active-status booking even if its slot does not overlap — this already works via slot_window, but a seeded Raj (phone 3) frequently has a lingering accepted booking that silently excludes him from dispatch. Dispatch pool should ignore bookings in terminal/cancelled states — in practice they already are, but we had to run a cleanup pass before the dispatch test could consistently include Raj. Consider documenting / fixturising a 'reset partner busy state' helper for tests.
seed_data_creation: Three test bookings were inserted with customer_id='test-cust-iter219' during dispatch tests and have been cleaned up at the end of the run. Vikash (phone 12) is unsuspended after the auto-suspend test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dispatch logic is exercised via a sidecar process (/app/backend/tests/_iter219_dispatch_sidecar.py) because motor's event loop binding leaks between pytest tests in the same process once booking_controller.db has been used. The sidecar seeds a paid booking (payment_status=paid, status=pending_payment) directly in Mongo and calls booking_controller._broadcast_new_job to drive the exact code path the real payment flow uses. If main agent later adds /api/payments/mock, the dispatch test can be refactored to use the real HTTP flow (recommended).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only speed-bump was the lack of /payments/mock which the review request mentioned; worked around via a sidecar invoking the dispatch controller directly.
